title: Imprint, which helps companies offer co-branded credit cards and manage loyalty programs, raised $130M led by Khosla Ventures at a ~$1.9B valuation (Alex Konrad/Upstarts Media)
summary: Alex Konrad / Upstarts Media: Imprint, which helps companies offer co-branded credit cards and manage loyalty programs, raised $130M led by Khosla Ventures at a ~$1.9B valuation — Imprint CEO Daragh Murphy's co-branded card startup is now solving loyalty for brands in agentic commerce. — ∙ Paid
contentText:
Alex Konrad / Upstarts Media :

Imprint, which helps companies offer co-branded credit cards and manage loyalty programs, raised $130M led by Khosla Ventures at a ~$1.9B valuation   —  Imprint CEO Daragh Murphy's co-branded card startup is now solving loyalty for brands in agentic commerce.  —  ∙ Paid
